jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Asset Management (Pictet AM) manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service.

Distribution Enablement empowers sales and marketing teams to engage clients more effectively by improving the data, insights, tools and ways of working that support commercial activity. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Technology and Operations, the team helps simplify how work gets done, identify opportunities to improve commercial effectiveness and ensure teams can scale consistent, client-focused growth.

Working within Distribution Enablement, this role will ensure that investments in enablement, data and AI translate into practical improvements in how teams work and deliver measurable business benefits. Working closely with local markets and central teams, the role will combine strategic change leadership with hands-on communication, training and day-to-day user support.

The role can be based in either Geneva or London, with regular travel between the two locations.

Your role

• Champion the evolution of AI-enabled ways of working, helping sales and marketing teams adopt new capabilities, develop best practices, and identify opportunities to leverage insights, automation and emerging agentic technologies in their day-to-day activities.

• Plan and deliver communications to Sales and Marketing on behalf of Distribution Enablement, ensuring teams understand what is changing, why it matters, what is expected of them and where they can access support.

• Act as the bridge between markets, users and central delivery teams, gathering feedback, resolving day-to-day user issues and ensuring business needs inform the ongoing development of tools and processes.

• Design and deliver training, coaching and adoption programmes, building a network of champions across markets and adapting support to different teams, roles and levels of readiness.

• Define and scale effective commercial practices across opportunity management, client intelligence and AI-enabled selling, measuring adoption, behaviour change and resulting business outcomes.

Your profile

• Over 7 years’ experience in change, sales enablement, transformation, training or adoption roles, ideally within Asset Management, Wealth Management or Finan-cial Services. Alternatively, over 5 years’ experience as a salesperson with deep knowledge of the sales process in Asset Management.

• Proven experience leading the adoption of new tools, insights and business processes across geographically dispersed sales or client-facing teams. Experience with generative and agentic AI is an advantage.

• Strong communication, facilitation and coaching skills, with experience in developing communications, trainings and practical user support for different audiences.

• Credibility with sales and marketing teams and the ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels, from shaping and delivering an adoption strategy and influencing senior stakeholders to resolving day-to-day user challenges.

• Comfortable working with CRM, data and AI workflows, with the ability to learn new capabilities quickly and partner effectively with Product Owners, Technology teams and data specialists.

• If based in Geneva, applicants must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Ref.: DCAL/AC/JHC

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

La tua squadra

Pictet Asset Management (Pictet AM) gestisce i beni di alcune delle più grandi istituzioni, intermediari finanziari e clienti del mondo. La nostra cultura accoglie pensatori e centri indipendenti intorno all'eccellenza degli investimenti, una prospettiva a lungo termine e una dedizione al servizio clienti.

Distribution Enablement consente ai team di vendita e marketing di coinvolgere i clienti in modo più efficace migliorando i dati, le informazioni, gli strumenti e i modi di lavorare che supportano l'attività commerciale. Lavorando a stretto contatto con le vendite, il marketing, la tecnologia e le operazioni, il team aiuta a semplificare il lavoro, identificare le opportunità per migliorare l'efficacia commerciale e garantire che i team possano scalare la crescita coerente e orientata al cliente.

Lavorare all'interno della distribuzione Enablement, questo ruolo assicurerà che gli investimenti in abilitazione, dati e AI traducono in miglioramenti pratici nel modo in cui i team lavorano e forniscono benefici aziendali misurabili. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i mercati locali e con i team centrali, il ruolo sarà quello di combinare la leadership dei cambiamenti strategici con la comunicazione, la formazione e il supporto dell'utente quotidiano.

Il ruolo può essere basato sia a Ginevra che a Londra, con viaggi regolari tra le due località.

Il tuo ruolo

• Campione l'evoluzione dei modi di lavoro, aiutando i team di vendita e marketing ad adottare nuove capacità, sviluppare le migliori pratiche e identificare le opportunità per sfruttare intuizioni, automazione e tecnologie agentiche emergenti nelle loro attività quotidiane.

• Pianifica e consegna le comunicazioni alle vendite e al marketing per conto di Distribution Enablement, assicurando ai team di capire cosa sta cambiando, perché conta, cosa ci si aspetta da loro e dove possono accedere al supporto.

• Agire come ponte tra i mercati, gli utenti e i team di consegna centrali, raccogliere feedback, risolvere problemi di utente di giorno per giorno e garantire le esigenze aziendali informare lo sviluppo continuo di strumenti e processi.

• Progettare e fornire programmi di formazione, coaching e adozione, costruire una rete di campioni sui mercati e adattare il supporto a diverse squadre, ruoli e livelli di disponibilità.

• Definire e scalare pratiche commerciali efficaci attraverso la gestione delle opportunità, l'intelligenza dei clienti e la vendita, la misurazione dell'adozione, il cambiamento di comportamento e i risultati aziendali che ne derivano.

Il tuo profilo

• Oltre 7 anni di esperienza nei ruoli di cambiamento, attivazione delle vendite, trasformazione, formazione o adozione, idealmente all’interno di Asset Management, Wealth Management o Finan-cial Services. In alternativa, oltre 5 anni di esperienza come venditore con profonda conoscenza del processo di vendita in Asset Management.

• Esperienza comprovata che conduce l'adozione di nuovi strumenti, approfondimenti e processi aziendali attraverso le vendite geograficamente disperse o i team di clienti. L'esperienza con l'intelligenza artificiale generativa e agentica è un vantaggio.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione, facilitazione e coaching, con esperienza nello sviluppo di comunicazioni, formazioni e supporto pratico per gli utenti per il pubblico diverso.

• Credibilità con i team di vendita e marketing e la capacità di operare a livello sia strategico che operativo, dalla definizione e realizzazione di una strategia di adozione e influenzando gli stakeholder senior per risolvere le sfide quotidiane dell'utente.

• Confortevole lavoro con CRM, dati e flussi di lavoro AI, con la capacità di imparare nuove funzionalità in modo rapido e efficace con i proprietari di prodotti, team tecnologici e specialisti dei dati.

• Se con sede a Ginevra, i candidati devono essere residenti in Svizzera o disposti a trasferirsi.

Dein Team

Pictet Asset Management (Pictet AM) verwaltet die Vermögenswerte einiger der weltweit größten Institutionen, Finanzintermediäre und deren Kunden. Unsere Kultur begrüßt unabhängige Denker und konzentriert sich auf Investitionsexzellenz, eine langfristige Perspektive und ein Engagement für den Kundenservice.

Distribution Enablement ermöglicht es Vertriebs- und Marketingteams, Kunden effektiver zu binden, indem es die Daten, Erkenntnisse, Tools und Arbeitsweisen verbessert, die kommerzielle Aktivitäten unterstützen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Marketing, Technologie und Betrieb hilft das Team, die Art und Weise der Arbeit zu vereinfachen, Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der kommerziellen Effektivität zu identifizieren und sicherzustellen, dass Teams ein konsistentes, kundenorientiertes Wachstum skalieren können.

Durch die Arbeit im Rahmen von Distribution Enablement wird diese Rolle sicherstellen, dass Investitionen in Enablement, Daten und KI zu praktischen Verbesserungen bei der Arbeitsweise von Teams führen und messbare Geschäftsvorteile bieten. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Märkten und zentralen Teams wird die Rolle strategische Change Leadership mit praktischer Kommunikation, Schulungen und täglichem Benutzersupport kombinieren.

Die Rolle kann entweder in Genf oder London angesiedelt sein, mit regelmäßigen Reisen zwischen den beiden Standorten.

Deine Rolle

• Verfechten Sie die Entwicklung von KI-fähigen Arbeitsweisen und unterstützen Sie Vertriebs- und Marketingteams dabei, neue Fähigkeiten zu übernehmen, Best Practices zu entwickeln und Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren, um Erkenntnisse, Automatisierung und neue Agententechnologien in ihren täglichen Aktivitäten zu nutzen.

• Planen und liefern Sie Kommunikationen an Vertrieb und Marketing im Auftrag von Distribution Enablement, um sicherzustellen, dass die Teams verstehen, was sich ändert, warum es wichtig ist, was von ihnen erwartet wird und wo sie auf Support zugreifen können.

• Handeln Sie als Brücke zwischen Märkten, Benutzern und zentralen Lieferteams, sammeln Sie Feedback, lösen Sie alltägliche Benutzerprobleme und stellen Sie sicher, dass Geschäftsanforderungen die laufende Entwicklung von Tools und Prozessen beeinflussen.

• Design und Durchführung von Schulungen, Coaching und Adoptionsprogrammen, Aufbau eines Netzwerks von Champions in allen Märkten und Anpassung der Unterstützung an verschiedene Teams, Rollen und Bereitschaftsniveaus.

• Definieren und Skalieren Sie effektive Geschäftspraktiken für Opportunity Management, Client Intelligence und KI-fähiges Verkaufen, Messen von Akzeptanz, Verhaltensänderung und daraus resultierenden Geschäftsergebnissen.

Dein Profil

• Über 7 Jahre Erfahrung in Change, Sales Enablement, Transformation, Training oder Adoption, idealerweise innerhalb von Asset Management, Wealth Management oder Finan-cial Services. Alternativ dazu über 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Verkäufer mit fundierten Kenntnissen des Verkaufsprozesses im Asset Management.

• Bewährte Erfahrung bei der Einführung neuer Tools, Erkenntnisse und Geschäftsprozesse in geografisch verteilten Vertriebs- oder Kundenteams. Erfahrung mit generativer und agentischer KI ist von Vorteil.

• Starke Kommunikations-, Erleichterungs- und Coaching-Fähigkeiten mit Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Kommunikation, Schulungen und praktischer Benutzerunterstützung für verschiedene Zielgruppen.

• Glaubwürdigkeit mit Vertriebs- und Marketingteams und die Fähigkeit, sowohl auf strategischer als auch auf operativer Ebene zu operieren, von der Gestaltung und Bereitstellung einer Adoptionsstrategie und der Beeinflussung leitender Stakeholder bis hin zur Lösung der täglichen Herausforderungen der Benutzer.

• Komfortables Arbeiten mit CRM-, Daten- und KI-Workflows, mit der Fähigkeit, schnell neue Funktionen zu erlernen und effektiv mit Product Ownern, Technologieteams und Datenspezialisten zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Wenn der Antragsteller in Genf ansässig ist, muss er in der Schweiz ansässig oder bereit sein, umzuziehen.

Votre équipe

Pictet Asset Management (Pictet AM) gère les actifs de certaines grandes institutions, intermédiaires financiers et leurs clients. Notre culture accueille des penseurs et des centres indépendants autour de l'excellence en investissement, d'une perspective à long terme et d'un dévouement au service à la clientèle.

Distribution Activer permet aux équipes de vente et de marketing d'engager plus efficacement les clients en améliorant les données, les idées, les outils et les façons de travailler qui soutiennent l'activité commerciale. En étroite collaboration avec Sales, Marketing, Technology and Operations, l'équipe aide à simplifier le travail, à identifier les occasions d'améliorer l'efficacité commerciale et à s'assurer que les équipes peuvent faire évoluer la croissance de façon cohérente et axée sur le client.

Travailler dans le cadre de l'habilitation de distribution, ce rôle permettra d'assurer que les investissements dans l'habilitation, les données et l'IA se traduisent par des améliorations pratiques dans la façon dont les équipes travaillent et offrent des avantages opérationnels mesurables. En étroite collaboration avec les marchés locaux et les équipes centrales, le rôle combinera le leadership du changement stratégique avec la communication pratique, la formation et le soutien quotidien des utilisateurs.

Le rôle peut être basé à Genève ou à Londres, avec des déplacements réguliers entre les deux endroits.

Votre rôle

• Promouvoir l'évolution des méthodes de travail adaptées à l'IA, aider les équipes de vente et de marketing à adopter de nouvelles capacités, développer des pratiques exemplaires et identifier des occasions de tirer parti des connaissances, de l'automatisation et des nouvelles technologies d'agents dans leurs activités quotidiennes.

• Planifier et fournir des communications aux ventes et au marketing pour le compte de Distribution Activement, en veillant à ce que les équipes comprennent ce qui change, pourquoi cela importe, ce qui est attendu d'elles et où elles peuvent avoir accès au soutien.

• Faire le pont entre les marchés, les utilisateurs et les équipes centrales d'exécution, recueillir des commentaires, résoudre les problèmes quotidiens des utilisateurs et veiller à ce que les besoins des entreprises éclairent le développement continu d'outils et de processus.

• Concevoir et exécuter des programmes de formation, de coaching et d'adoption, créer un réseau de champions sur tous les marchés et adapter le soutien aux différentes équipes, rôles et niveaux de préparation.

• Définir et mettre à l'échelle des pratiques commerciales efficaces à l'échelle de la gestion des possibilités, des renseignements sur les clients et de la vente, mesure de l'adoption, du changement de comportement et des résultats commerciaux.

Votre profil

• Plus de 7 ans d'expérience dans le changement, la facilitation des ventes, la transformation, la formation ou les rôles d'adoption, idéalement dans la gestion d'actifs, la gestion de patrimoine ou les services financiers. Alternativement, plus de 5 ans d'expérience en tant que vendeur avec une connaissance approfondie du processus de vente dans Asset Management.

• Expérience éprouvée menant à l'adoption de nouveaux outils, de nouvelles idées et de nouveaux processus d'affaires auprès d'équipes de vente ou de clients dispersées géographiquement. L'expérience de l'IA générique et agentique est un avantage.

• De solides compétences en communication, en facilitation et en coaching, avec une expérience dans le développement des communications, des formations et du soutien pratique des utilisateurs pour différents publics.

• Crédibilité auprès des équipes de vente et de marketing et capacité de fonctionner aux niveaux stratégique et opérationnel, de l'élaboration et de la mise en oeuvre d'une stratégie d'adoption et de l'influence des intervenants supérieurs à la résolution des défis quotidiens des utilisateurs.

• Travail confortable avec les flux de travail CRM, de données et d'IA, avec la capacité d'apprendre de nouvelles capacités rapidement et efficacement en partenariat avec les propriétaires de produits, les équipes technologiques et les spécialistes des données.

• S'ils sont établis à Genève, les demandeurs doivent résider en Suisse ou être disposés à déménager.

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 27 offices in financial centers worldwide and currently employs over 4,300 people.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group offers comprehensive services for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

The Pictet Investment Office (PIO) is a specialized investment team within Pictet Wealth Management, dedicated to serving a select group of large families and principals. PIO manages substantial wealth portfolios through a distinctive investment approach that combines public and private markets, with a strong emphasis on long-term equity ownership, concentrated conviction and unconstrained capital allocation.

We are seeking to recruit an Intern (Investment Analytics & AI Applications). Your mission will be to support the Pictet Investment Office in leveraging data science, quantitative analytics and artificial intelligence to enhance investment research, portfolio construction, risk management and implementation across public and private markets.

Your role

• Develop AI applications to support investment research and decision-making.
• Build quantitative tools and analytics for portfolio construction, asset allocation, risk management and implementation.
• Leverage data and automation to enhance investment research workflows.
• Partner with investment teams across asset classes to improve investment processes through technology and data.

Your profile

• Master's student in Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science or a related quantitative field.
• Strong interest in investing, financial markets and technology.
• Excellent programming skills, preferably in Python.
• Familiarity with data analysis and Generative AI tools.
• Interest in applying AI and quantitative techniques to real-world investment and portfolio management challenges.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with investment professionals across disciplines.
• Proficient in standard productivity tools (MS Office).
• Excellent command of English; French is an advantage.

Start date: : February / March 2027

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment group and a wholly owned subsidiary of Pictet with expertise in hedge funds, private equity, real estate, private debt and infrastructure. With teams based globally, PAA constructs, manages and advises portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients.
You will be part of a team of 20 professionals dedicated to Pictet’s pan-European Direct Real Estate franchise, which began in 2019 with the launch of Elevation Fund I, a EUR 700 million value-add fund. Elevation Fund II was launched in 2023, and a Core Plus fund, with approximately EUR 200 million under management, was launched in 2021. The team is distributed across several locations: in London, where the core investment and asset management teams are based; in Geneva, where the investment legal and investor relations teams operate; and in Berlin and Stockholm, where our regional heads are located. Additionally, fund support functions such as fund administration, compliance, and legal affairs are situated in Luxembourg and London.

Your role

As part of the Direct Real Estate team based in Geneva you will:

• Lead the review, drafting and negotiation of a wide range of real estate and financing documents, including shareholders’ agreements, financing agreements, lease agreements, SPAs, construction agreements, etc.

• Support direct real estate transactions from inception to closing, helping to drive execution by coordinating legal workstreams, managing negotiations and liaising with internal stakeholders and external advisers.

• Act as a key legal partner on cross-border matters, working closely with internal teams across jurisdictions on transaction status, documentation, payment mechanics and related execution steps.

• Provide day-to-day legal support on asset management and project matters, combining strong technical legal drafting with a practical, commercially minded and solutions-oriented approach to business issues, focused on finding practical solutions to the team’s challenges rather than acting solely as a gatekeeper.

• Lead and support legal documentation for development, construction and refurbishment matters, including preparing, revising and finalising project and works contracts for counterparties.

Your profile

• Between 5 and 8 years post-qualification in the real estate department of a major and reputable law firm ideally completed by in-house experience, and have experienced leading acquisitions, disposals and financings (beyond due diligence support or minor supporting roles).

• Experience working on transactions in at least 3 different jurisdictions.

• The candidate should have flexibility to travel within Europe for business purposes.

• Fluent in English, any additional European language such as French, Spanish, German or Danish would be an asset.

• You have a particular interest of and existing experience with AI tools for task/workflow automation.

• Resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

As the selected candidate, you have developed a passion for real estate and are seeking to be involved in exciting real estate projects. You are a strong and dedicated professional who genuinely values team spirit and is comfortable with the level of commitment that an M&A role naturally involves, given the pace and unpredictability of live transactions.
With a flat hierarchy and a collaborative culture, success comes from teamwork, open information sharing, and constructive debate, enabling you to learn quickly, contribute meaningfully, and grow. If you are excited about the role but do not meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to providing a supportive environment where people can grow.

Ref: LA/LT/MMC

The Pictet Investment Research Institute is an advanced investment research capability within Pictet Group, established in 2024.

The Institute’s goal is to conduct in-depth research on topics with long-term implications for Pictet’s business on topics ranging from geopolitics to macroeconomics to portfolio implementation issues.

We are looking for a recent PhD graduate to join the internal team of researchers and contribute to the research output of the Institute. The term of the contract is two years. At the end of the two-year period, the researcher will have the opportunity to be considered for permanent research positions within the Institute.

Your role

• Contribute to research projects of importance to the Pictet Institute.
• Work closely with the Head of the Pictet Institute to formulate the research methodology of the projects and perform the empirical analysis.
• Work closely with the other members of the Institute’s research team on advancing the individual projects, from the research stage to the completion and distribution of the published papers.
• Interact with academics affiliated with the Institute on matters related to the Institute’s research agenda.
• Contribute to writing the research papers on an as-needed basis.

Your profile

• PhD in Finance or a related field from an accredited institution. Individuals without a PhD will not be considered.
• Strong coding skills in Matlab, Python and SQL.
• At ease working with other researchers or investment professionals as well as alone, as necessary.
• Good communication skills, both oral and written, as well as ability to convey complex subject matters to a non-technical audience in a precise and concise manner.

Diese Funktionen werden von Spezialisten mit Fachwissen in allen Geschäftsbereichen wahrgenommen und umfassen die Abteilungen Kommunikation, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finanzen, Personal, Informationssicherheit, interne Revision, Recht, Risiko, Strategie & Projekte und Steuer.

Das Pictet Investment Research Institute ist eine fortschrittliche Anlageforschungseinrichtung innerhalb der Pictet Group, die 2024 gegründet wurde.

Ziel des Instituts ist es, eingehende Forschung zu Themen mit langfristigen Auswirkungen auf das Geschäft von Pictet zu Themen durchzuführen, die von Geopolitik über Makroökonomie bis hin zu Fragen der Portfolioimplementierung reichen.

Wir suchen einen kürzlichen Doktoranden, der sich dem internen Forscherteam anschließt und zur Forschungsleistung des Instituts beiträgt. Die Laufzeit des Vertrags beträgt zwei Jahre. Am Ende der zweijährigen Laufzeit hat der Forscher die Möglichkeit, für unbefristete Forschungsstellen innerhalb des Instituts in Betracht gezogen zu werden.

Deine Rolle

• Beitrag zu Forschungsprojekten, die für das Pictet-Institut von Bedeutung sind.
